items.name: plotter
items.title: Plotter
items.description: Seeded line-drawing generators (flow fields, contours, globes, tunnels, rosettes, harmonographs, spirals, Lissajous knots, ridgelines, routes, hatching) and scrollWindow(), the trigger that finishes a drawing as it reaches the middle of the screen. Every scrollfx block draws with it.

items.name: hero-flow-field
items.title: Hero, flow field
items.description: A hero beside a print: a round flow field of several hundred strokes, plotted top to bottom on arrival, with a live stroke count.

items.name: hatch-highlight
items.title: Hatched highlight
items.description: A large statement whose key phrases a pen hatches over as they are read, like a proof marked up by hand.

items.name: plotted-chart
items.title: Plotted chart
items.description: Figures that count up beside an area chart a pen plots as you scroll: hatched in from left to right, the curve drawn over it.

items.name: feature-plates
items.title: Feature plates
items.description: Features beside plates a pen draws as you reach them: a topographic map, a wireframe globe, a tunnel of turning squares.

items.name: steps-route
items.title: Steps on a route
items.description: How it works as a route on a map: numbered stops a pen rings in turn, joined by a line that wanders from one to the next and ends on a cross.

items.name: changelog-plotted
items.title: Plotted changelog
items.description: Releases down a rail that inks itself as you read, each stamped with a rosette drawn from its version number.

items.name: pricing-plotted
items.title: Plotted pricing
items.description: Plans headed by marks that grow denser with the plan, the recommended one framed by a pen that goes round it twice, and prices that count.

items.name: testimonials-plotted
items.title: Plotted testimonials
items.description: Quotes on sheets, each stamped with a spiral a pen winds from the rim inward, seeded from the person's name, with their initials in its eye.

items.name: team-plotted
items.title: Team with fingerprints
items.description: The people behind the product, each over a fingerprint seeded from their name, drawn ring by ring from the core outward.

items.name: faq-plotted
items.title: Plotted FAQ
items.description: Questions that open in place with the browser's own disclosure, beside a plate where a pen draws a Lissajous knot.

items.name: newsletter-plotted
items.title: Starburst sign-up
items.description: A newsletter sign-up beside a starburst a pen draws ray by ray, clockwise from the top, with every twelfth ray in the accent colour.

items.name: cta-harmonograph
items.title: Harmonograph call to action
items.description: The closing call to action beside a harmonograph: one unbroken line, the trace of two pendulums, drawn as the section arrives.

items.name: footer-plotted
items.title: Plotted footer
items.description: A footer under a horizon of ridgelines a pen plots back to front as it comes into view, with link columns and a closing line below.
